operative_clauses.original_operative_text:
G. Joseph Minetti, Member, Civil Aeronautics Board, became subject to manda­
tory retirement for age on July 31, 1977, under the provisions of Section 8335 of Title  
5 of the United States Code unless exempted by Executive Order. Mr. Minetti was  
exempted from mandatory retirement until September 30, 1977, by Executive Order  
No. 12006 of July 29, 1977, and until October 31, 1977, by Executive Order No. 12011  
of September 30, 1977.
In my judgment, the public interest requires that G. Joseph Minetti continue to  
be exempted from such mandatory retirement.

I hereby exempt G. Joseph  
Minetti from mandatory retirement until January 31, 1978.
